_README: Settings for the daily TikTok post. Safe to edit. See README.md.

cities._README: Which city each day's post is about. Every day must appear exactly once.

_storyDays: Days that post tips, myths and culture (stories.json). Other days post the venue lists (topics.json). Put a day back to venues by removing it here.

buffer._scheduling: notification = Buffer sends a notification to your phone at the set time; you add a sound in TikTok and post. automatic = Buffer posts by itself (no sound choice).
